root_idea.summary: The root is oriented toward cutting something rapidly across or transversely, producing a separated or sharply delimited portion.
root_idea.development: From transverse cutting develop meanings involving a cut-off share or written allotment, as well as related descriptions of contracted hair and light, broken precipitation. The particle قَطْ meaning “enough” is treated separately as an alteration of قَدْ rather than as a direct development of this root.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The group is a Quran-attested nominal represented by the normalized citation form قِطّ.

senses.definition: An allotted portion, share, or lot, including a due assigned as reward or recompense.
senses.usage_conditions: In رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ, the word may refer to the requested allotted share or due before the Day of Reckoning; exegetical readings include a share of Paradise or of punishment.

senses.definition: A written allotment, record, or document, especially a written statement or obligation specifying a due payment or gift.
senses.usage_conditions: In the same Quranic expression, the word is also understood as the written reckoning or entitlement to be delivered. This interpretation is distinct from, but applies to, the same Quranic form as the sense “share.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut across, crosswise, or transversely; to cut or trim a hard object or an edge into an even form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is opposed to قَدَّ, which denotes cutting lengthwise. The verb is also used of nibbing a writing reed and paring a beast’s hoof. The quasi-passive form انْقَطَّ denotes being or becoming cut.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Crisp, curly, twisted, contracted, and short hair; also an epithet for a person characterized by such hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description may refer to hair that is especially tightly curled or contracted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dear or high in price; of a price, dear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: قَطَّ السِّعْرُ is the verbal construction, while قَاطٌّ is an adjectival description of the price.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the sky, to let fall rain or hail, especially the light precipitation called قِطْقِطٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: مُقَطْقِطَةٌ describes a sky producing such precipitation.
Used as a prefixed noun or verbal noun equivalent to حَسْبُ or كَفَى, in expressions such as قَطْكَ and قَطْنِي, with several grammatical variants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Only; no more; a limiting expression for a restricted amount.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It occurs especially in limiting or negative expressions. Some analyses of فَقَطْ explain it as a verbal noun meaning “stop” or “abstain from further questioning,” while others relate it to satisfaction or sufficiency.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ever or hitherto, throughout the past time up to the present.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is normally used in negative statements about past time, though occurrences after affirmative clauses are also reported; it is not normally used for the future.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slice or piece cut off, especially of a melon or similar object.
An hour or portion of the night.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: قِطَّةٌ is reported as the term for a female cat, although its status as genuine Arabic is disputed in the cited lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of cutting, especially the cut made at the extremity of a writing-reed nib.
A maker or turner of small boxes or containers called حُقَق.
Small rain or drizzle; also small hail, or hail or rain of the kinds described in the lexical tradition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is used for light precipitation, with descriptions differing over whether the precipitation is rain, hail, or continuously falling larger drops.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where the extremities of a horse’s ribs end, or a rib extremity projecting over the belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural مَقَاطّ refers to the paired extremities of the horse’s belly, extending from the sternum toward the pubic region.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small bone or similar support on which a writing reed is cut or nibbed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is the implement used by writers or paper sellers for cutting the extremities of reeds.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference to the first cutting statement.

cautions: The single Quran occurrence supports two materially different interpretive readings: an allotted share or recompense, and a written allotment or document. The supplied contextual gloss “our share” reflects the first reading.
The particle قَطْ meaning “enough” and the adverb قَطُّ meaning “ever” are distinct Classical Arabic items and should not be conflated with the Quranic noun قِطّ.
